result.title: Recovering Reliable Supervision via Critique-Guided On-Policy Distillation
result.summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student model on its own rollouts with token-level supervision from a teacher, assuming that the teacher can reach a correct answer from any prefix the student writes. We call this property the recoverability of the teacher and show it fails on incorrect rollouts: the teacher follows student errors, although it recognizes them. We propose CriticOPD, using error recognition to restore recoverability. The teacher critiques an incorrect rollout, allowing the student to rewrite its solution following the error. The resulting output, including the critique as privileged information, is scored by the teacher while the student uses the revision without the critique for training. On two Qwen3 students and six mathematical reasoning benchmarks, CriticOPD improves OPD, with the largest gains on competition problems.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究 on-policy distillation 中教师无法从学生的错误前缀恢复出正确答案（即 recoverability 失效），提出 CriticOPD：由教师批评学生错误 rollout 并引导其改写，改写成稿连同批评作为特权信息被评分，学生则仅用不含批评的修订轨迹训练。
AI.relevance_reason: 属纯文本推理的蒸馏监督方法，未涉及视觉或 latent 状态；其「错误识别 + 特权信息改写 + 学生仅见修订轨迹」的监督构造，或可为 LVR 在错误中间状态下如何构造轨迹监督、分配各步贡献提供可核查线索。
